Repeat over different hub/rattler deletion triples, because this directly changes which points carry contacts instead of perturbing the entire jammed configuration.

Unfreeze the configuration for a short LP polish, cycle through several distinct hubs, and accept patches based on the final full maximum rather than repeatedly restarting only from the global best.
